title: Doppler, Infisical, Bitwarden and KeePassXC
description: Four more secret managers, a secret browser and a redesigned settings page.

Added: {{doppler.*}} references from Doppler configs (service or personal token)
{{infisical.*}} references from Infisical (Universal Auth machine identity or access token), with folders and imports
{{bitwarden.*}} references from the Bitwarden password manager via bw serve, with unlock, lock and sync from the settings page
{{keepass.*}} references from KeePassXC databases via keepassxc-cli (password and/or key file, TOTP)
Browse secrets tab: find a secret and copy its reference; values are never shown
Test connection now tests the form as typed, before saving
Per-provider status in the settings sidebar, updated by real requests
Changed: Redesigned settings page: provider sidebar, Connection / Browse secrets / How to use tabs, unsaved-changes tracking, ⌘S / Ctrl+S to save
Settings from 1.0.x (Vault address, token, cache) are migrated automatically

title: Initial release
description: Use HashiCorp Vault secrets in requests as {{vault.path#field}}, resolved at send time.

Added: {{vault.*}} references resolved from HashiCorp Vault (KV v1 and v2) when a request is sent
Settings tab with connection test; token encrypted with the OS keychain
Per-environment overrides via VAULT_ADDR, VAULT_TOKEN, VAULT_NAMESPACE and VAULT_MOUNT
Short-lived secret cache (configurable, can be turned off)
Error toasts explaining why a secret could not be read
